title: Omics-guided global rewiring of yeast metabolism enables high-level production of beta-lactoglobulin
one_line_finding: Omics-guided engineering of ATP5/GDH3/IDH1/PPI1 plus amino-acid feeding gave 13.88 g/L bovine beta-LG in K. phaffii bioreactor fermentation, methanol-free; authors claim the highest beta-LG titer in yeast to date.

title: High-level expression of bovine beta-lactoglobulin in Pichia pastoris and characterization of its physical properties
one_line_finding: Classic benchmark: >1 g/L secreted bovine BLG variant A from P. pastoris Mut+ under pAOX1 with the alpha-MF prepro leader; product physically indistinguishable from native BLG.

title: Expression and secretion of bovine beta-lactoglobulin in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
one_line_finding: First secretion of bovine BLG from S. cerevisiae under the GAPDH promoter with its native signal; only 1.1 mg/L by sandwich ELISA.

title: Expression and secretion of recombinant ovine beta-lactoglobulin in Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Kluyveromyces lactis
one_line_finding: K. lactis gave 40-50 mg/L ovine BLG (72% of secreted protein) under pPGK with the native signal, ~12x better than S. cerevisiae (3-4 mg/L); secretion required correct disulfide formation.

title: Production of bovine beta-lactoglobulin and hen egg ovalbumin by Trichoderma reesei using precision fermentation technology and testing of their techno-functional properties
one_line_finding: Filamentous-fungal benchmark: 1 g/L bovine BLG (and 2 g/L ovalbumin) from T. reesei; product N-glycosylated mostly Man5, emulsification matching bovine BLG.

title: Characterization of glycosylated variants of beta-lactoglobulin expressed in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Engineered 1-3 N-glycosylation sites into BLG in P. pastoris; glycans Man9-15GlcNAc2 high-mannose, confirming P. pastoris hyperglycosylation risk for dairy proteins. No titer reported.

title: The effect of the bgs13 mutation on the structure of the reporter protein beta-lactoglobulin: influence on folding and aggregation in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Uses BLG as a secretion reporter to show the bgs13 supersecretion mutation alters folding/aggregation state of the secreted product. No absolute titer.

title: Food proteins from yeast-based precision fermentation: simple purification of recombinant beta-lactoglobulin using polyphosphate
one_line_finding: Hexametaphosphate precipitation at acidic pH raised BLG purity from 26 to 72 wt% from P. pastoris broth, matching anion-exchange chromatography without harming emulsification; key downstream-cost result.

title: beta-lactoglobulin from precision fermentation and milk exhibit similar protein structure but distinct aggregation behaviour: a multi-length-scale perspective
one_line_finding: Vivici/Fonterra/dsm-firmenich comparison of fermentation-derived vs milk BLG: equivalent primary-to-quaternary structure but different aggregation behaviour. No titer.

title: Biosensor-guided rapid screening for improved recombinant protein secretion in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: UPR/secretion biosensor screen for improved P. pastoris secretion, with BLG among the reporters; reports relative, not absolute, titers.

title: Enhanced production of bovine beta-lactoglobulin in an industrial Aspergillus oryzae host: a step forward in alternative protein biomanufacturing
one_line_finding: DoE on pH, temperature and carbon input in Ambr250 bioreactors gave 79% more BLG product and 73% better carbon yield in A. oryzae TFB-Ao0024; all values are relative - no absolute g/L published.

title: Mycotoxin-free Aspergillus oryzae strain lineage for alternative and novel protein production at industrial scale
one_line_finding: Describes the mycotoxin-free A. oryzae lineage behind a GRAS-cleared animal-free bovine beta-lactoglobulin; host-safety and regulatory context, no titers.

title: Efficient bioproduction of human milk alpha-lactalbumin in Komagataella phaffii
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
one_line_finding: First secretory human alpha-LA in K. phaffii: 5.2 mg/L baseline in X33, raised to 56.3 mg/L in a 3 L bioreactor via alpha-MF signal, pAOX1 and hPDIA3 co-expression.

title: Ethanol-inducible bioproduction of human alpha-lactalbumin in Komagataella phaffii
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
one_line_finding: Methanol-free ethanol-inducible signal-amplification system took human alpha-LA from 7.39 to 16.52 mg/L in flasks and 0.60 g/L in a 3 L bioreactor once acetate accumulation was controlled.

title: Efficient expression of bovine alpha-lactalbumin in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
one_line_finding: Bovine alpha-LA fused to the alpha-MF prepro leader was secreted as active, native-identical protein from S. cerevisiae, but only at neutral culture pH; no titer given.

title: Expression and secretion of goat alpha-lactalbumin as an active protein in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
one_line_finding: Goat alpha-LA secreted as precise mature protein from S. cerevisiae under the GPD promoter with full lactose-synthase activity; no titer given.

title: Secretion of glycosylated alpha-lactalbumin in yeast Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Shows N-glycosylation at Asn45 suppresses alpha-LA secretion in P. pastoris: the N45D non-glycosylated mutant secreted far more, implicating ER quality-control degradation of glycoforms.

title: Precision fermentation of kappa-casein using Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Only published kappa-casein titers in P. pastoris: 28/89/133 mg/L in flasks at 1/7/17 copies and ~10 mg/L single-copy in bioreactor, with heavy proteolysis, periplasmic retention and extensive O-glycosylation; yps1/pep4 knockouts did not fix it.

title: Enhancing heterologous expression of bovine casein macropeptide via promoter engineering
journal: Sheng Wu Gong Cheng Xue Bao (Chinese Journal of Biotechnology)
one_line_finding: pAOX1 mutant library (FACS-screened, +59-160% strength) plus alpha-factor signal and fermentation optimisation took bovine casein macropeptide to 1.02 g/L in P. pastoris.

title: Production of human caseinomacropeptide in recombinant Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Pichia pastoris
journal: Journal of Industrial Microbiology and Biotechnology
one_line_finding: 2.5 g/L human caseinomacropeptide in a S. cerevisiae fed-batch bioreactor at 97 h under a galactose-inducible promoter; S. cerevisiae outperformed P. pastoris.

title: Expression and purification of glycosylated bovine beta-casein (L70S/P71S) in Pichia pastoris
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
one_line_finding: Key precedent for beta-casein in P. pastoris: up to 30% of expressed beta-casein carried an Asn68 high-mannose glycan, and the product was phosphorylated to the same degree as native bovine beta-casein. No titer reported.

title: Production of phosphorylated and functional alphaS1-casein in Escherichia coli
one_line_finding: Bacterial kinase co-expression produced phosphorylated, functional alphaS1-casein in E. coli - the state of the art on the casein phosphorylation bottleneck, but in a bacterial host (out of yeast scope).

title: Foam stabilization by two genetic variants of recombinant alphaS1-casein
journal: Journal of Colloid and Interface Science
one_line_finding: Interfacial/foaming comparison of recombinant alphaS1-casein variants A and B; functional-performance evidence for precision-fermented casein, no production host or titer.

title: Recombinant bovine alphas1-casein ameliorates PCPA-induced insomnia-like behavioral and physiological abnormalities in mice
one_line_finding: In vivo bioactivity of recombinant bovine alphaS1-casein as a food ingredient; no production host or titer reported.

title: Structure of biomimetic casein micelles: critical tests of the hydrophobic colloid and multivalent-binding models using recombinant deuterated and phosphorylated caseins
one_line_finding: Uses recombinant phosphorylated caseins to test micelle-assembly models - relevant to whether yeast-made casein can form micelles. No titer.

title: High-level expression of recombinant bovine lactoferrin in Pichia pastoris with antimicrobial activity
one_line_finding: 3.5 g/L recombinant bovine lactoferrin from P. pastoris KM71-H under pAOX1 in batch fermentation, with antibacterial activity against E. coli and S. aureus; the quoted yield follows cell lysis so the secreted fraction is unclear.

title: Production of bioactive porcine lactoferrin through a novel glucose-inducible expression system in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Replacing pAOX1 with the glucose-inducible PG1 promoter gave ~2.8 g/L porcine lactoferrin in a 5 L fermenter, vs 87 mg/L for the same group's methanol system; methanol-free route for a milk glycoprotein.

title: Reprogrammed Komagataella phaffii for enhanced secretory expression of human lactoferrin
one_line_finding: ER-membrane expansion plus vacuolar-protease knockout plus 0.1 g/L FeCl3 raised secretory intact human lactoferrin 76-fold to 2214 mg/L in a 5 L bioreactor.

title: Harnessing Yarrowia lipolytica as a platform for animal-free and secretory production of human lactoferrin
one_line_finding: First Y. lipolytica hLF platform: 409.9 mg/L in flasks and 3.14 g/L in 5 L fed-batch; raising gene copy number alone did not raise extracellular yield and harmed growth.

title: Biosynthesis and functionalization of recombinant bovine lactoferrin: alginate-mediated stabilization and MTGase-induced gelation for anthocyanin delivery
one_line_finding: Signal-peptide engineering plus chaperone co-expression gave 232.6 mg/L recombinant bovine lactoferrin in P. pastoris flasks, then formulated it into alginate nanocomplexes and MTGase hydrogels.

title: A system for production of commercial quantities of human lactoferrin: a broad spectrum natural antibiotic
one_line_finding: Glucoamylase-fusion expression in Aspergillus awamori plus classical strain improvement exceeded 2 g/L human lactoferrin, KEX2-processed to the mature protein with full iron-binding activity.

title: Production of biologically active recombinant human lactoferrin in Aspergillus oryzae
one_line_finding: First fungal hLF production: 25 mg/L secreted under the A. oryzae alpha-amylase promoter, correctly N-glycosylated and N-terminally processed.

title: Producing human lactoferrin by high-density fermentation recombinant Pichia pastoris
journal: Zhonghua Shi Yan He Lin Chuang Bing Du Xue Za Zhi
one_line_finding: Fed-batch high-density fermentation of P. pastoris KM71 reached A600 >260 and 115 mg/L human lactoferrin, 7.67x the shake-flask level.

title: Expression, characterization, and purification of recombinant porcine lactoferrin in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: pGAP-driven, alpha-MF-secreted porcine lactoferrin reached ~12 mg/L in P. pastoris (vs 1-2 mg/L in S. cerevisiae); pH 7.0 and 100 uM ferric ion both improved secretion, and signal-less constructs went insoluble intracellularly.

title: Expression, purification, and characterization of equine lactoferrin in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: First intact lactoferrin from P. pastoris: 40 mg/L equine LF in shake flasks via pPIC9K, correctly folded and iron-binding but hyperglycosylated by GS115.

title: Expression and purification of goat lactoferrin from Pichia pastoris expression system
one_line_finding: Constitutive pGAP expression gave only ~2.0 mg/L purified goat lactoferrin from P. pastoris X-33, glycosylated by the host but functionally comparable to native LF.

title: Molecular cloning, expression and purification of lactoferrin from Tibetan sheep mammary gland using a yeast expression system
one_line_finding: >60 mg/L Tibetan sheep lactoferrin secreted from P. pastoris GS115 via pPICZalphaA, correctly folded with antimicrobial and iron-binding activity.

title: Molecular cloning and expression of yak (Bos grunniens) lactoferrin cDNA in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Yak lactoferrin cloned and expressed in P. pastoris as correctly folded, antimicrobial 76 kDa protein; abstract gives no titer (the 40 mg/L figure is only a secondary citation elsewhere).

title: Functional analysis of recombinant buffalo lactoferrin and monoferric lobes and their cytotoxic effect on buffalo mammary epithelial cells
one_line_finding: Buffalo lactoferrin and its N- and C-lobes expressed in Kluyveromyces lactis or Pichia pastoris with native-like iron handling; no production titer given.

title: Recombinant human lactoferrin expressed in glycoengineered Pichia pastoris: effect of terminal N-acetylneuraminic acid on in vitro secondary humoral immune response
one_line_finding: GlycoFi glycoengineered P. pastoris made sialylated and non-sialylated human-type hLF glycoforms, showing yeast glycan control is achievable for milk glycoproteins; no titer reported.

title: Expression of the hybrid antimicrobial peptide lactoferrin-lysozyme in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: pGAP-driven LfcinB-human lysozyme fusion secreted at 15.7 mg/L from P. pastoris GS115 with activity against E. coli K88 and S. aureus.

title: Structure and function of fermentation-derived bovine lactoferrin produced from Komagataella phaffii
one_line_finding: TurtleTree/UC Davis comparability study: K. phaffii-made bovine lactoferrin (84 kDa, high-mannose glycans) matches native bLf in iron handling, receptor binding and LPS antagonism. No titer - regulatory-equivalence evidence.

title: Workshop report: a study roadmap to evaluate the safety of recombinant human lactoferrin expressed in Komagataella phaffii intended as an ingredient in conventional foods
one_line_finding: Consensus safety-assessment roadmap for K. phaffii-made human lactoferrin as a food ingredient; regulatory context for the dairy-protein-in-yeast route.

title: Evaluation of the potential food allergy risks of human lactoferrin expressed in Komagataella phaffii
one_line_finding: Allergenicity risk assessment of K. phaffii-expressed human lactoferrin; supports food use, no production data.

title: Recombinant human lactoferrin: a valuable protein for pharmaceutical products and functional foods
one_line_finding: Review of hLF production hosts and applications; useful secondary source for host comparison but titers in it are second-hand.

title: Medium optimization for high yield production of human serum albumin in Pichia pastoris and its efficient purification
one_line_finding: Halving BSM salt concentration gave 17.47 g/L rHSA in P. pastoris supernatant over 192 h induction - the highest secreted yeast titer found in this sweep and the practical ceiling benchmark for a large disulfide-rich secreted protein.

title: High level expression and purification of recombinant human serum albumin in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: G418 screening plus induction optimisation gave 1.6 g/L rHSA in flasks and 8.86 g/L in a fermenter after 96 h methanol induction.

title: Maximizing recombinant human serum albumin production in a MutS Pichia pastoris strain
one_line_finding: Induction cell density (285 g/L WCW) and low specific growth rate (<=0.0024/h) drove rHSA broth titer to 10 g/L in a MutS strain; a template for process design in dairy-protein fermentations.

title: High-level expression of recombinant human serum albumin from the methylotrophic yeast Pichia pastoris with minimal protease production and activation
one_line_finding: Nitrogen starvation, not the strain, caused protease bursts that destroyed rHSA; raising ammonia/phosphate gave stable 1.4 g/L. Directly relevant to casein proteolysis control.

title: High level production of stable human serum albumin in Pichia pastoris and characterization of the recombinant product
one_line_finding: Three-copy rHSA cassette gave nearly 1 g/L in flasks with 1.8-2.5x higher transcript levels; bioreactor productivity 300 mg/L/d with minimal proteolysis.

title: Systematic engineering of COPII machinery and cell wall remodeling enables gram-level secretion of recombinant human serum albumin with native-like structural features in Kluyveromyces marxianus
one_line_finding: COPII (SEC23/SEC13/SEC31) plus cell-wall gene knockouts raised extracellular rHSA 316% and reached 2.32-2.37 g/L in 5 L fed-batch in the food-safe host K. marxianus, with all 17 native disulfides intact.

title: Enhanced production of human serum albumin by fed-batch culture of Hansenula polymorpha with high-purity oxygen
one_line_finding: High-purity oxygen sparging gave 5.1 g/L HSA in a 5-L and 4.5 g/L in a 30-L fermentor with H. polymorpha GOT7, 2-10x air-based controls.

title: Optimization of heterologous protein production process using genetically engineered Ogataea minuta toward industrial-scale manufacturing
one_line_finding: A prb1/aox double mutant of Ogataea minuta reached ~7.5 g/L HSA in 21 days, and the same conditions scaled a different protein to a 4500 L bioreactor.

title: Use of the KlADH4 promoter for ethanol-dependent production of recombinant human serum albumin in Kluyveromyces lactis
one_line_finding: Ethanol-inducible KlADH4 promoter plus multicopy vectors took rHSA from 0.3 g/L in batch to 1 g/L in fed-batch in K. lactis.

title: Physiological approach to heterologous human serum albumin production by Kluyveromyces lactis in chemostat culture
one_line_finding: Chemostat study: rHSA output tracked cell concentration and glycolytic flux; best 62 mg/L at D=0.12/h, and fermentative metabolism suppressed heterologous synthesis. Reported 75 mg/L/h productivity is internally inconsistent.

title: Secretion of human serum albumin by Kluyveromyces lactis overexpressing KlPDI1 and KlERO1
one_line_finding: Co-duplicating KlPDI1 and KlERO1 accelerated HSA secretion and improved growth in K. lactis - a folding-capacity lever transferable to disulfide-containing whey proteins. No absolute titer in abstract.

title: The secretion of human serum albumin from the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae using five different leader sequences
one_line_finding: Compared five KEX2-processed leaders for HSA secretion in S. cerevisiae: leader choice changed both quantity and fidelity of product. No titers in abstract.

title: Development of expression systems for the production of recombinant human serum albumin using the MOX promoter in Hansenula polymorpha DL-1
one_line_finding: Removing the HSA 5'-UTR gave >=5x translational improvement and abolished the gene-dosage effect; a mox-disrupted host secreted more HSA with correct prepro processing. No absolute titer in abstract.

title: Cytokinetic engineering enhances the secretory production of recombinant human lysozyme in Komagataella phaffii
one_line_finding: ARTP mutagenesis pointed to MYO1/IQG1; deleting MYO1 gave 1,052,444 U/mL activity and 4.12 g/L supernatant total protein in fed-batch - best hLYZ production in yeast, with O-mannose glycans on the product.

title: A combinational strategy for effective heterologous production of functional human lysozyme in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Codon optimisation, six gene copies and ER chaperone co-expression gave 0.22 mg/mL (220 mg/L) secreted human lysozyme in flasks.

title: Efficient expression of human lysozyme through the increased gene dosage and co-expression of transcription factor Hac1p in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Four HLY copies gave 436.99 ug/mL extracellular protein, and adding Hac1p (UPR) raised it to 517.82 ug/mL with 78,600 U/mL activity in flasks.

title: Highly efficient expression and secretion of human lysozyme using multiple strategies in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: G418 screening, signal optimisation, VPS10 disruption and chaperone co-expression gave 81,600 U/mL in flasks and 352,000 U/mL in a 5 L fermenter on a cheaper RDMY medium; activity units only, no mg/L.

title: Efficient secretion of human lysozyme from the yeast, Kluyveromyces lactis
one_line_finding: Chromosome-integrated pPGK construct secreted ~100 ug/mL human lysozyme from K. lactis, ~10x episomal vectors; an extra PDI copy helped further.

title: Production of human lysozyme in biofilm reactor and optimization of growth parameters of Kluyveromyces lactis K7
one_line_finding: Plastic-composite-support biofilm reactor plus Box-Behnken optimisation for K. lactis K7 hLYZ; activity units (U/mL) only.

title: Effects of fed-batch and continuous fermentations on human lysozyme production by Kluyveromyces lactis K7 in biofilm reactors
one_line_finding: Fed-batch with continuous lactose feeding gave 187 U/mL hLYZ vs 173 U/mL batch; continuous mode gave the best volumetric productivity. Activity units only.

title: Enhanced productivity of human lysozyme by pH-controlled batch fermentation of recombinant Saccharomyces cerevisiae
one_line_finding: pH control raised hLYZ from 42.3 to 74.5 U/mL in S. cerevisiae batch fermentation; a pH-shift strategy shortened the run. Activity units only.

title: Human lysozyme secretion increased by alpha-factor pro-sequence in Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: The alpha-MF prepro leader secreted 20x more human lysozyme than three alternative signal peptides in P. pastoris, and the pro region (not the spacer) was the critical element.

title: Efficient secretory expression of human milk osteopontin in Komagataella phaffii
one_line_finding: Only published hOPN-in-yeast titer series: 340.5 ug/L in X33 rising through promoter/signal, transcription and translation factor and CPR5 chaperone engineering to 35.6 mg/L in flasks and 128.5 mg/L in a 3-L bioreactor.

title: Production of recombinant human proteins in Komagataella phaffii using a sucrose-utilization-based selection marker without antibiotic resistance
one_line_finding: An A. flavus sucrose hydrolase (SucF, engineered T65A/R322Q/S323G) works as an antibiotic-free dominant selection marker in K. phaffii and was used to secrete human lactoferrin and human osteopontin; no titers reported.

title: Osteopontin as an emerging multifunctional food ingredient: recent advancements, production, applications, and challenges
journal: Critical Reviews in Food Science and Nutrition
one_line_finding: Review of osteopontin production routes and food applications; useful for framing the recombinant-OPN opportunity, titers second-hand.

title: Recombinant bovine and human osteopontin generated by Chlamydomonas reinhardtii exhibit bioactivities similar to bovine milk osteopontin when assessed in mouse models
one_line_finding: Algal (non-yeast) recombinant bovine and human OPN matched milk OPN bioactivity in mice - the main non-yeast comparator for recombinant milk OPN.

title: Recombinant bovine lactoperoxidase as a tool to study the heme environment in mammalian peroxidases
one_line_finding: Recombinant bovine lactoperoxidase produced for heme-environment studies in a non-yeast system; no yeast/fungal expression or titer. Closest available prior art for LPO.

title: Expression and characterization of bovine lactoperoxidase by recombinant baculovirus
one_line_finding: Bovine LPO expressed in insect cells via baculovirus; confirms LPO recombinant production has not moved to yeast or fungal hosts.

title: Toward rational design of precision-fermented milk proteins: integrating cross-species selection, post-translational modification, and AI optimization
journal: Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety
one_line_finding: Collates host selection, PTM requirements and AI-guided design for precision-fermented milk proteins; the best single secondary source for the tractability hierarchy. Not open access in Europe PMC - could not mine its tables.

title: Precision fermentation for animal-free dairy proteins: microbial chassis, molecular fidelity, downstream processing, and the route to economic and regulatory viability
one_line_finding: Preprint review of chassis choice, fidelity, downstream processing and economics for animal-free dairy proteins; not peer reviewed, treat all numbers in it as low confidence.

title: Komagataella phaffii (Pichia pastoris) as a powerful yeast expression system for biologics production
one_line_finding: General K. phaffii expression-platform review; host-engineering context for secretion, promoters and glycosylation.

title: Characterization of the exopolysaccharides produced by the industrial yeast Komagataella phaffii
journal: Journal of Industrial Microbiology and Biotechnology
one_line_finding: Characterises the K. phaffii extracellular mannan/polysaccharide that fouls dairy-protein purification - the contaminant the polyphosphate purification route works around.

title: Dynamic genome-scale metabolic modeling of the yeast Pichia pastoris
one_line_finding: Dynamic genome-scale model of P. pastoris; the modelling substrate for predicting metabolic burden of dairy-protein overexpression.

title: Harnessing the PpHog1 regulatory network to engineer a UPR-adaptive Komagataella phaffii chassis for high-copy secretory protein production
one_line_finding: Hog1-network engineering produces a UPR-adaptive K. phaffii chassis that tolerates high gene copy number - directly relevant to the copy-number ceiling seen for kappa-casein.
